title: Sky Reaper — Farmlands final report
status: Final demo report; latest 201 saved checks pass

route.method: One cumulative first pass; actual bought caps, bot weapons and real Viper collection. No ride renders, free rewards or forced arrivals.
route.validation: One cumulative save; real purchases using earned wallets, normal rewards, bot weapons plus Viper collector, HP9999. No free currency, forced arrivals or ride rendering. This validates economy/accounting, not human difficulty.
route.seeds: Each real ride uses0x680+leg; one cumulative save remains intact between rides.

testing.method: All 201 scenarios ran sequentially once. After 13 stale fixture corrections, the shared F-4 burn tooltip fix and a performance fix, 18 focused checks and two final checks ran sequentially. The aggregate retains the latest passing result for each scenario; a second full sweep was not run.
testing.performanceRepair: An intermediate performance check measured 8.10/8.23 ms; redundant exact-output HUD work was removed before the passing final measurement.
testing.screenshotPolicy: Final screenshots captured from current fixtures. The user waived manual image review; no claim of final manual visual approval is made.

performance.metric: Headless average ms per frozen render+UI frame; not real device FPS
performance.interpretation: Final worst sampled average7.66 ms is below8 ms, with one late atlas page. It is4.39 ms above the initial3.27 ms baseline; this does not establish performance on every device.

save.legacy: Old v1 saves reset rather than migrate.

humanApprovedResolutions.text: Remove Viper overheating: continuous fire and no Cooling node.
Keep five existing cars: MG turrets on boxcar index 3, Katyusha on flatcar index 2 replacing its riders.
Retain the short won/lost summary before returning to the Depot.
Keep large readable hordes and reduce fractional kill payouts to meet the per-leg scrap targets.
Cap extra one-time Gold Hunt rewards at five gold across the demo.
Reveal gold on the first actual leg-3 gold reward, including arrival stars if the golden zombie escapes, and open the leg-2 chest then.
Award remaining missed rescues at the final Terminus camp, including rescue events that never spawned, so no survivor is permanently lost.

numericInventory.title: Design-specified values
numericInventory.classification: Design requirements; distinct from chosen implementation proposals
entries: Every unit unlock costs 1 survivor. Rockets chances are 5/8/11/14/18%, with a 6 s bad-luck guarantee and first rocket within 3 s after purchase.
Plane cooldowns/floors: A-10 25/12 s, F-4 30/15 s, B-52 45/25 s, B-2 60/40 s. Katyusha starts with 6 rockets per 15 s; B-52 starts with 8 bombs.
Two saved demo slots Q/W; a +1 Charge holds two strikes. The finale gate holds for 30 game seconds; its runtime B-2 gift has one charge per attempt.
Route introductions: runners leg 2, gold/stars leg 3, silver leg 4, first wall leg 5, brutes leg 6 and explosive zombies leg 7. Rescue identities are legs 4/8/10.

configurationAppendix.source:
// tree.js - the skill tree. One table, NODES, drives all of it: the map on the SKILL TREE tab of the
// Depot, how each node looks, the tooltip (what it does, NOW > NEXT, the price), buying, and the goal
// line under the summary. What a node does in a run is read from the UP numbers (game.js, and the new
// ones below), the same numbers the tooltip shows.
// The look: a dark starry panel with glowing nodes and lines around VIPER. Drag to move the map,
// use the wheel to zoom, and C to centre it. Blue is scrap, orange is survivors, and gold is gold.

// ---------- colours and numbers
// Each kind of node: c = bright, m = mid, d = dark (the body when maxed), g = its glow.
const NODE_KIND = {
  root: { c: '#ffd36a', m: '#a07a30', d: '#2e2410', g: '#ffb040' },
  scrap: { c: '#62c8ff', m: '#2f6f9e', d: '#0b2234', g: '#2a9dff' },
  surv: { c: '#ffa448', m: '#a55a1e', d: '#331b08', g: '#ff7a1a' },
  gold: { c: '#ffd36a', m: '#a07a30', d: '#2e2410', g: '#ffb040' },
  tease: { c: '#3a4458', m: '#202838', d: '#10141c', g: '#3a4458' }
};
// A value with its unit, for the tooltip. (2 px on the ground = 1 m.)
const perS = (v) => +v.toFixed(1) + '/S', secs = (v) => +v.toFixed(1) + ' S', metres = (px) => Math.round(px / 2) + ' M';
const pctS = (v) => Math.round(v * 100) + '%';
const TRACKS = {
  A: [15, 23, 34, 51, 76, 114, 171, 256],
  B: [20, 30, 45, 68, 101, 152],
  C: [25, 38, 56, 84, 127],
  D: [30, 45, 68, 101, 152],
  E: [40, 60, 90, 135],
  F: [40, 64, 102, 164]
};

// ---------- node values
// These are the demo's numbers at level l; treeUp snapshots them for every active system.
Object.assign(UP, {
  hdmg: (l) => 1 + 0.2 * l,
  hrate: (l) => 1 + 0.12 * l,
  hrange: (l) => 1 + 0.15 * l,
  rockets: (l) => [0, 0.05, 0.08, 0.11, 0.14, 0.18][l],
  podDamage: (l) => 1 + 0.25 * l,
  podReload: (l) => [8, 7, 6, 5.5, 5][l],
  podSalvo: (l) => 4 + l,
  napalm: (l) => l ? 3 : 0,
  hellfireDamage: (l) => 1 + 0.3 * l,
  hellfireReload: (l) => 10 - l,
  hellfireBlast: (l) => 1 + 0.2 * l,
  doubleHellfire: (l) => l ? 2 : 1,
  mgDamage: (l) => 1 + 0.25 * l,
  mgRate: (l) => 2 * (1 + 0.15 * l),
  mgRange: (l) => 1 + 0.15 * l,
  mgTurrets: (l) => 1 + l,
  apRounds: (l) => l ? 3 : 1,
  katyushaRockets: (l) => 6 + 2 * l,
  katyushaReload: (l) => 15 - 1.5 * l,
  katyushaBlast: (l) => 1 + 0.2 * l,
  clusterRockets: (l) => l ? 3 : 0,
  ramPower: (l) => 1 + 0.3 * l,
  ramCooldown: (l) => 20 - 2 * l,
  ramDuration: (l) => 2 + 0.5 * l,
  shockwave: (l) => l > 0,
  steamDamage: (l) => 1 + 0.25 * l,
  steamSpeed: (l) => [5, 4.4, 3.8, 3.2, 2.5][l],
  steamReach: (l) => l,
  hotCloud: (l) => l ? 2 : 0,
  a10Damage: (l) => 1 + 0.25 * l,
  a10Cooldown: (l) => [25, 22, 19, 16, 14, 12][l],
  a10Lines: (l) => 1 + l,
  bombRun: (l) => l ? 4 : 0,
  a10Charge: (l) => 1 + l,
  fireDamage: (l) => 1 + 0.25 * l,
  f4Cooldown: (l) => 30 - 3 * l,
  fireLength: (l) => 1 + 0.2 * l,
  fireDuration: (l) => 4 + l,
  fireWall: (l) => l ? 12 : 4,
  fireBurn: (lengthLevel, wallLevel) => wallLevel > 0 ? UP.fireWall(wallLevel) : UP.fireDuration(lengthLevel),
  f4Charge: (l) => 1 + l,
  b52Bombs: (l) => 8 + 2 * l,
  b52Cooldown: (l) => 45 - 5 * l,
  b52Blast: (l) => 1 + 0.2 * l,
  fireBombs: (l) => l > 0,
  b52Charge: (l) => 1 + l,
  salvageCrew: (l) => 0.08 * l,
  // Rare variant birth chances; Hunt levels add to the chance, not the death roll. (proposal)
  silver: (l) => 0.004 + 0.003 * l,
  boom: (l) => 0.006 + 0.006 * l,
  goldHunt: (l) => l
